title: Application Specialist
desc:
Job Description
As being one of the core brand of Rolls Royce Power Systems, Rolls Royce Solutions Türkiye is equipped with the experience of more than 100 years on productions of diesel engines, manufactures and improves complete drive systems, Gas and Diesel Systems and their control / monitoring systems in wide range of product types and power ratings for heavy vehicles and equipment for construction and mining industry.
Key Accountabilities
Bachelor degree (Preferably; Mechanical, Electric & Electronic Engineer, Naval Architecture or Marine Engineering)
Having at least 3 years of relevant experience
Fluent speaking and writing in English
Knowledge of MS Office tools, Autocad and SAP applications
Team player, self-motivated, result oriented
Problem solver and analytic minded
Strong relationship and high communication skills
We are looking for Application Specialist for Marmara Region of Turkey who have the following qualifications;
Conformity check of the engines and equipment in the first delivery stage
Before the operation of the application system, documentation, necessary tools, preliminary and complete transfer to the work area
Conducting technical preliminary customer visit within the scope specified in the contracts and checking and reporting of project suitability until that stage of the operations
According to the RRPS regulations, coordinating with the customer side in accordance with the occupational health and safety in the light of the field visit reports and findings, completing and reporting the necessary fields
Performing and reporting customer and users test of completed engines in accordance with RRPS regulations
Providing technical support according to the customer demand in the completed applications
Support Sales team
